<!-- pr-reviewer: 9bd9fcbd848ddfcaae8b123798cb291cba5bee7f -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers found (safety-floor review, read in full and built on the runner).

**What looks good**
- Display only, by construction: `Stock::with_partial` (`crates/sim/src/stock_sim/partial.rs`) clones the completed-move stock, drains the copy's ledger and cuts the sub-move on the copy. `FieldPlay::cur`, the checkpoints and the whole-move path are never written by it; only `view()` reads `partial`. `seek_to(k+1, 0.0)` is the plain `seek(k+1)`, and `f >= 1` returns the move itself, so a full move is the same stock main produces. Nothing in the diff touches a verdict or post path.
- Arcs are cut along the arc: `partial_move` uses `sim::point_along` (factored unchanged out of `at_seg`, so it is the drawn tool's position) and keeps the arc's centre and direction.
- Degenerate input: NaN, infinite, negative, tiny fractions, zero-length and non-finite moves give no cut. No unwrap/expect/panic on the new paths. Rotary and lathe ops are refused partial display by name in the module law, with the reason in the decision file.
- Bounded cost: one stock clone plus one sub-move sweep, only when the fraction changes (`request_at` and `next_target` compare bits). `partial` and `partial_bricks` are dropped on every move change, and the ghost set is re-sent once so no stale partial bricks stay on screen.
- Placement: sim tests are in `camcraft-sim`, app tests in `crates/app/tests` (they use app's `FieldPlay` and worker). `stock_play.rs` went from 398 to 397 lines, and the split-out `stock_play_head.rs` is 128. `stock_play_worker.rs` is 378 and `sim.rs` is 1193 (it was 1185 before this PR, so the growth is small). The playhead position is ephemeral, so no command is needed. No new `camcraft-*` dependency, no snapshot PNGs, no process files, and no dependency, build or script changes.

**Results merged with main** (on the self-hosted runner, main f1de41a5c: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43518851606, conclusion success)
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: sim suites ok, motion suites ok, app suites ok, ui suites ok (0 failed, 6.0 min).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The diff has no `cfg(windows)` or per-OS reading, so no local re-run was owed.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. I read the new tests rather than running them against the old code. The APIs they call (`seek_to`, `with_partial`, `request_at`, `travelled`) do not exist there, so they could not compile on main. The bit-equality pins (`seek_to(k+1, 0.0)` against `seek(k+1)`, and the whole-fraction sample equality) are what guard the "final stock is identical" law.
2. A full-circle arc (`from == to`) is treated as zero-length and shows no partial cut until it completes. It is safe, and the old behaviour stays. A follow-up could cover it.
3. As the body says, the live playback picture was not looked at in the GUI. It needs a hand test.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
